content.short: Solidity Coverage provides code coverage for Solidity smart-contracts.
content.description: Solidity Coverage is a testing tool that helps developers understand how Solidity code behaves during execution, revealing vulnerabilities that tests may miss. It provides a coverage API to verify whether the apps being built are covered, and the Istanbul test reports generated during runs are useful for analysis. The project is used by about 50,000 Solidity developers and benefits from a growing, open-source community of contributors.
